## [v0.87.0](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/tag/v0.87.0)
*GitHub Releases · Crush* | 24/07/2026 | Score: 0.70
Tags: model_release, evaluation, research_paper

> <h1>MCP OAuth, performance and more</h1> <p>Happy Friday everybody!</p> <p>We're releasing some nice features for you so you can enjoy your weekend vibecoding. (Or not, stay outside 🌞 and return to Crush on Monday! 😃).</p> <h2>MCP OAuth</h2> <p>That's it, it's finally here! Some of you have been asking for this for long.</p> <p>This is required for some MCPs to work. Want to know to it set it up? <a href="https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush#mcp-oauth">Refer to this section into the README</a>.</p> <p>Thank <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/joestump/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/joestump">@joestump</a> and his agent <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/joestump-agent/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/joestump-agent">@joestump-agent</a> for this contribution. And of course, our favorite <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/taciturnaxolotl/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/taciturnaxolotl">@taciturnaxolotl</a> also helped.</p> <h2>Claude Channels MCP extension</h2> <p><a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/joestump/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/joestump">@joestump</a> (and his agent) <em>also</em> added an initial implementation to support the <a href="https://code.claude.com/docs/en/channels-reference" rel="nofollow">Claude Channels MCP extension</a>, which means MCPs can now send notifications to Crush when certain events happen.</p> <p>Give this a try if you're interested, and let us know how well it works for you.</p> <h2>Restored MCP prompts</h2> <p>MCP prompts were unintentionally disabled in a previous release, but they were now added back!</p> <h2>LSP performance boost</h2> <p>Another cool contrib was made by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/TheJhyeFactor/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/TheJhyeFactor">@TheJhyeFactor</a>, who vastly improved the CPU and memory usage on handling LSP servers in large repositories!</p> <p>See <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4922746509" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/issues/3370" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/charmbracelet/crush/pull/3370/hovercard" href="https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/3370">#3370</a> for a more in-depth explanation of the optimizations.</p> <h2>Bang mode performance boost</h2> <p><a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/TheJhyeFactor/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/TheJhyeFactor">@TheJhyeFactor</a> <em>also</em> improved performance of output streaming when running command in bang mode.</p> <p>Check <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4928375063" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/issues/3381" <h2><code>/etc/crush/crush.json</code></h2> <p>You read it right! Thank to <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Muttaqin86/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Muttaqin86">@Muttaqin86</a> you can now have a system-wide Crush configuration on <code>/etc/crush/crush.json</code>.</p> <p>The motivation for this was improving compatibility with NixOS.</p> <h2>Fixed Copilot + GPT-5.6</h2> <p>All three GPT-5.6 models (Sol, Terra and Luna) are now fixed when running via GitHub Copilot. Kudos to <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/nghiant03/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/nghiant03">@nghiant03</a> for this!</p> <p>That was a lot, but it's really fun to how much the community is enganged with Crush dev.</p> <p>Keep Crushing! ™️<br> Charm</p> The notice explains that this is expected behavior for the first deployment and that future deployments will be preview deployments unless <code>--prod</code> is used. In non-interactive mode, the hint is included in the JSON payload and the "Promote to production" next command is omitted since the deployment is already production.</li> <li><a class="commit-link" data-hovercard-type="commit" data-hovercard-url="https://github.com/vercel/vercel/commit/6e297457aaf615cf98ef19bd522e19230dc28d37/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/vercel/commit/6e297457aaf615cf98ef19bd522e19230dc28d37"><tt>6e29745</tt></a>: Gate the native CLI binary trampoline behind an explicit opt-in. The native <code>@vercel/vc-native-*</code> binary is only spawned when the user opts in via <code>vercel upgrade --enable-binary</code> (or the <code>useNativeBinary</code> global config flag); members of the <code>vercel</code> team are auto-opted-in when their teams are already loaded.
